preview_no_files_will_change_and_no_prog: Preview: no files will change and no program will restart.
a_previous_maintenance_operation_was_int: A previous maintenance operation was interrupted. Previous files were preserved. You can retry or restore the previous files.
restoring_restarts_the_app_and_preserves: Restoring restarts the app and preserves the new configuration until recovery is validated. Disconnected accounts must be linked again.
